summary: Practise phishing detection, BEC verification, and incident reporting. Build practical employee awareness campaign skills. Explore the course.
lede: Phishing awareness training helps employees recognize suspicious messages and respond safely to social engineering attempts. For employees, managers, and awareness leads, it covers analysing message cues, verifying unusual payment requests, protecting credentials, and reporting suspected compromise. It also addresses AI-generated lures, practical awareness campaign planning, and tracking reporting and response trends.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for employees who handle workplace email, customer interactions, executive requests, sensitive information, or workforce awareness responsibilities. It is suitable for mixed-function teams that need shared, practical responses to phishing and social engineering.
modules: Message Analysis and NIST Phish Scale
Campaign Controls and CIS Controls v8
prerequisites: Comfort using workplace email and basic web applications is helpful. No coding or cybersecurity administration experience is required. Exercises use example messages and campaign data; bring a laptop with Excel if you want to complete the tracking exercise digitally.
